email_subject: 500 Internal Server Error in payment webhook ingress service
email_body:
Hello Engineering Team,

We are experiencing intermittent HTTP 500 Internal Server Errors in our production payment webhook ingress service since 06:30 UTC today.
The stack trace points to a NullPointerException in WebhookHandler.java line 142 during Redis session lookup.
Around 12% of incoming webhooks are failing with connection pool exhaustion:
java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "SessionPool.getConnection()" because "this.pool" is null.

Could you please investigate and push a patch to the hotfix branch?

Best regards,
Sarah Jenkins
Infrastructure Operations Lead
Phone: +1 415-555-8291
MegaCorp Technologies
